description: Sierra Leone OSM Roads data attributed with road surface classification is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by MapAction. Nov 2014 OSM data with attribute classifying roads by surface material/quality. Coverage: Sierra Leone. The portal files it under the publisher MapAction. Its tags are disease, geodata, roads, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-08-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
